A '''hidden droid factory''' had been built on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. In that facility, the Empire designed and built a [[Unidentified Imperial assassin droid|new series]] of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. An [[Unidentified Rebel agent (droid builder)|agent]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was tasked with locating that hidden factory and [[Programmer/Legends|reprogramming]] the assassin droids into harmless ones.
